company_description: Brookfield Corporation is a global investment company specializing in real asset management (infrastructure, renewable energy, real estate, etc.) and long-term wealth creation. It invests through three pillars: asset management, wealth solutions, and operating businesses, leveraging stable, inflation-indexed cash flows that generate high risk-adjusted returns.

kpis.name: Distributable Earnings Before Realization
kpis.explanation: Key measure of recurring cash flow generated by operations, excluding one-time gains.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed by Brookfield on behalf of third parties, a key driver of fee generation.

kpis.name: Cash Dividend
kpis.explanation: Annual cash payment distributed to shareholders, reflecting distribution capacity.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Consolidated accounting profit after taxes, impacted by gains and non-recurring adjustments.

kpis.name: Adjusted Trading Price
kpis.explanation: Closing price on the NYSE, adjusted for stock splits.

kpis.name: Operating Employees
kpis.explanation: Total headcount employed in owned operating businesses, an indicator of operational scale.

kpis.name: Investment Professionals
kpis.explanation: Number of specialists dedicated to investment and asset management within the ecosystem.

kpis.name: Special Distribution
kpis.explanation: One-time distribution of assets or cash to shareholders, outside regular dividends.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management Growth
kpis.description: Sustained organic and external AUM growth, driven by global demand for infrastructure and energy transition, strengthening the recurring fee engine.

kpis.name: Stable Distributable Earnings
kpis.description: Resilience of recurring cash flow despite cycles, supported by inflation-indexed contracts and high margins, key for shareholder distributions.

kpis.name: Global Presence
kpis.description: Operations in over 50 countries, enabling geographic diversification and access to unique opportunities through the Brookfield ecosystem.

kpis.name: Leadership in Renewables
kpis.description: Leading position in renewable energy through Brookfield Renewable, a strategic growth driver in the energy transition.

kpis.name: Disciplined Capital Allocation
kpis.description: Proven ability to generate 15%+ annualized returns over the long term, supported by investment discipline and active operational management.

risks.description: Exposure to global economic cycles, including interest rates and economic growth, which may affect real asset valuations and capital demand.
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, strong language on market volatility, upward trend in risk N-1, high weight in the business model.

risks.description: Evolving financial and environmental regulations across the multiple jurisdictions where Brookfield operates, potentially impacting costs and operating conditions.
risks.score_rationale: Frequently mentioned in risks, moderate intensity, stable compared to N-1, medium importance for assets under management.

risks.description: Increasing pressure to align investments with environmental, social, and governance criteria, with reputational risks in case of non-compliance.
risks.score_rationale: High positioning in the report, strengthened language, upward trend, growing weight in client investment decisions.
